pages.title: Charm Magazine
pages.text: A charm-slot container that holds folded talismans plus spare paper. Every loaded folded talisman stays active at the same time, and the pocket auto-folds one spare paper into each empty folded slot.
Right-click the pocket (or click it in your inventory) to open its talisman magazine and arrange the loadout. Its tooltip previews the contents, so you can check charges at a glance.
